_note: Alumni: 'now' is the most recent position we know of; older entries date from the 2022 site. Update 'now' when you hear news.

current.name: Charles Gawad, MD, PhD
current.bio: Chuck is an Associate Professor of Pediatrics at Stanford Medicine and a practicing pediatric oncologist. He invented primary template-directed amplification (PTA) and co-founded BioSkryb Genomics. Outside of work he enjoys anything outdoors in the Bay Area and spending time with his family.

current.name: Veronica Gonzalez-Pena, PhD
current.bio: Veronica received her PhD in Pharmacology and Toxicology from the University of Arizona. In the lab she is passionate about working out the details of new biotechnology methods. In her free time she enjoys gardening and spending time with her family.

alumni.name: Athena Aragon
alumni.bio: Athena joined the lab in 2021 after earning her bachelor's in Human Biology at UC Santa Cruz and worked on single-cell sequencing of pediatric leukemia and neural tissue.

alumni.name: Yakun Pang, PhD
alumni.bio: Yakun received her PhD in Internal Medicine (Hematology) from Peking Union Medical College. In the lab she studied pediatric acute leukemia with single-cell genomic and transcriptomic sequencing and led the longitudinal clonal evolution study of pediatric ALL.

alumni.name: Kartika Wardhani, PhD
alumni.bio: Kartika received her PhD in Chemistry from the University of Sydney and worked on new single-cell chemistry in the lab.

alumni.name: David Klein
alumni.bio: David received a BA in Biology from NYU and an MS in Biomedical Sciences from Tufts, then worked on computational analysis of single-cell and cell-free sequencing data.
alumni.now: Internal medicine resident, Santa Clara Valley Medical Center

alumni.name: Brandon Cai
alumni.bio: Brandon studied Molecular and Cell Biology and Public Health at UC Berkeley and worked on single-cell data analysis in the lab.

alumni.name: Shawn Schulz
alumni.bio: Shawn majored in Molecular and Cell Biology at UC Berkeley and applied data science to the lab's -omic data.
alumni.now: MS student in Computational Biology, UC Berkeley

alumni.name: Syahmi Ali Mohd Rizal
